entities.title: Card and destination preserve one logical event identity
entities.definition: Every visible event card opens the canonical matching event or selected occurrence; title, event ID, occurrence family and destination cannot drift or duplicate.

entities.title: Static core remains available
entities.definition: Public listing, event detail, navigation and safe static actions remain usable without optional Search, personalization, analytics, identity or provider runtime.
unresolved_conflicts: Public root rollout is still NO-GO, so full root evidence is incomplete.

entities.title: Curated membership is source-grounded and versioned
entities.definition: A collection, festival, club, exhibition or semantic context consumes accepted event IDs and receipts; Astro/UI cannot infer membership from arbitrary prose.
unresolved_conflicts: Some semantic labels remain blocked pending owner gold.

entities.title: No filler or fabricated relevance
entities.definition: When eligible supply or exact Search results are insufficient, the product shows honest absence or a separately labeled fallback rather than fabricated exact, related or personalized results.

entities.title: No duplicate logical event family in one continuation
entities.definition: Current event, explicit occurrence siblings, hidden/recently served events and duplicate normalized families are excluded according to the accepted relation contract.
unresolved_conflicts: Exact title recall is not authority to merge distinct events.

entities.title: Related labels reflect evidence state
entities.definition: Only a compatible verified related projection is labeled as related; raw, rejected, stale or not-run candidates are absent or explicitly fallback, never upgraded by UI copy.

entities.title: Critical event facts agree across surfaces
entities.definition: Title, occurrence, timezone, city, venue, address, admission, lifecycle and canonical URL agree between card, detail, JSON-LD, ICS, share and relevant messages.
unresolved_conflicts: Recent stale-publication incident prevents a global healthy status.

entities.title: Media treatment follows semantic role
entities.definition: Photographic visual-only media fills its accepted frame without distortion or fields; OCR/document/poster/protected regions remain readable; broken/missing media uses a typed fallback.

confidence.basis: Owner media decision and extensive acceptance matrix.

unresolved_conflicts: Not every UI consumer is migrated to one promoted media contract.

entities.title: One Search submission causes one physical Search request
entities.definition: A platform cell sends exactly one bounded Search POST; duplicate transport, pagination, LLM and forbidden side calls remain zero in health scope.

entities.title: Search result IDs equal rendered and opened cards
entities.definition: The exact result identity returned by Search matches the rendered large cards and the canonical event route opened from one card.

entities.title: Search match feedback appears only at the terminal exact-result boundary
entities.definition: `Нашли то, что искали?` is absent while exact results may continue and appears only after exact exhaustion or explicit zero-result state.

entities.title: Alternative feed is separate from exact Search results
entities.definition: Fallback recommendations appear after terminal feedback under a separate heading and are never represented as exact matches for the submitted query.

entities.title: Strong action state follows authoritative acknowledgement
entities.definition: Save, hide, restore and other internal strong actions update the UI and analytics from an idempotent durable product receipt, not an unconfirmed browser click.
unresolved_conflicts: Not every external intent action has a trusted terminal callback.

entities.title: One logical event produces one saved state
entities.definition: Repeated save, retry, reload, account merge or occurrence-family presentation cannot create duplicate saved event, reminder or Favorites entries.
unresolved_conflicts: Cross-device/account merge evidence remains incomplete.

entities.title: Intent action targets the exact selected occurrence
entities.definition: Calendar, reminder, route, ticket or registration uses the selected occurrence's date/time/location and canonical identity, not a sibling or stale occurrence.
unresolved_conflicts: Native calendar/map evidence remains release-specific.

entities.title: Unconfirmed attempts are not displayed as success
entities.definition: Cancelled, denied, timed out, rejected, ambiguous or navigation-only attempts receive typed honest states and are not counted as completed product outcomes.

entities.title: Share uses the canonical current event target
entities.definition: Native share, copy and downstream preview use the exact current canonical event URL and safe current metadata, never a secret/preview/personal URL.
unresolved_conflicts: Production root canonical promotion is not complete.

entities.title: Maps handoff targets the named event location
entities.definition: Route action opens the verified named venue/address/coordinates for the event rather than an arbitrary unnamed or geolocated point.
unresolved_conflicts: Real map-application verification remains native/manual.

entities.title: Transport is eligible, feasible and fresh
entities.definition: Transport context appears only for supported events, allows arrival before start and promised return after end, and uses fresh or honestly labeled last-good provider data.
unresolved_conflicts: Schedule freshness gate remains a release blocker.

entities.title: Account and local state remain isolated
entities.definition: Logout, account switch, multiple tabs and anonymous-to-account merge cannot expose or overwrite another user's email, saved events, profile or Search tags.
unresolved_conflicts: Full multi-device evidence remains incomplete.

entities.title: Static, contextual and personalized modes are explicit
entities.definition: The product does not call a static/cold-start/contextual feed personalized or infer a mature profile when compatible activation/profile evidence is absent.
unresolved_conflicts: Exact production coverage by mode is incomplete.

entities.title: Personal relevance retains controlled exploration
entities.definition: Mature personal feeds satisfy category, venue, geography and family diversity constraints and keep accepted exploration/rescue candidates when eligible supply permits.
unresolved_conflicts: Accepted thresholds and causal uplift evidence remain incomplete.

entities.title: Incompatible or unavailable personalization falls back safely
entities.definition: Missing, stale, incompatible or reset profile state produces a useful current static feed rather than an empty block or restoration from stale cache.
unresolved_conflicts: Service worker/history/back reset non-regression remains an acceptance gap.

entities.title: Action-map diagnostics create no profile or ranking mutation
entities.definition: Active diagnostic capture, when separately approved, may produce reviewed aggregate evidence but cannot create profile facets, change rank or become an implicit training signal.
unresolved_conflicts: Active capture remains default-off and is not part of this Git-only delivery.

entities.title: Recovery state is typed and actionable
entities.definition: No-result, offline, timeout, rejected command, expired session, stale state and failed release are distinguishable and offer a capability-appropriate next action.
unresolved_conflicts: Coverage differs across route and capability states.

entities.title: Usefulness, improvement, event issue and relationship NPS remain distinct
entities.definition: Feedback trigger, wording, storage, denominator and decision use match its purpose; overall NPS is not shown as a constant per-page prompt.
unresolved_conflicts: Cross-page production binding is not fully normalized.

entities.title: Raw feedback content stays in the protected feedback contour
entities.definition: Free text, screenshots and diagnostic attachments are not copied into general analytics or Product Atlas; only opaque IDs, typed metadata and reviewed findings cross the boundary.
unresolved_conflicts: Unified deletion/export evidence remains incomplete.

entities.title: Product/UI foreign keys resolve or remain pending
entities.definition: Every linkage resolves exact product and corrected UI IDs; unknown Penpot bindings are typed `binding_pending`, never guessed from coordinates, display text or unpublished UUIDs.

confidence.basis: Product Atlas authority and current Git-only boundary.

unresolved_conflicts: Actual Penpot shape/page bindings were intentionally not read in this task.

entities.title: ADD-V12-13 — One styled listing shell
entities.definition: Built Today, Tomorrow, Weekend and Popular routes resolve the shared listing shell, sticky stack and bounded media without horizontal overflow.
unresolved_conflicts: Cross-browser sticky behavior remains broader than the current Chromium evidence.

entities.title: ADD-UI-02 — Boundary viewports
entities.definition: Narrow phone, landscape, tablet and pre/post breakpoint contexts avoid overflow and discontinuous layout behavior.

entities.title: ADD-DISC-03 — Idempotent generated tag or curated page
entities.definition: The same normalized intent/result identity does not create duplicate pages or navigation entries; pending/rejected state is not public.

confidence.basis: Canonical scenario; full implementation coverage differs by curated family.

unresolved_conflicts: Not every curated family uses the same generated-tag pipeline.

entities.title: ADD-RECENT-01 — Interest-club projection gate
entities.definition: Only approved/fresh club identities and accepted event relations reach public manifest/sitemap; deferred/review/stale states do not leak.

confidence.basis: Canonical scenario and production canary context.

unresolved_conflicts: Individual club browser observations may remain unresolved in the corrected route registry.

entities.title: ADD-RELATED-05 — One continuation geometry and EventCard behavior
entities.definition: Related and broader continuation use the same canonical EventCard behavior, media framing and skeleton geometry.
unresolved_conflicts: Design-system promotion remains open.

entities.title: ADD-RELATED-06 — Diverse mixed continuation
entities.definition: At most six cards exclude current/prior/hidden/recent-served identities, respect diversity caps and label relation evidence honestly.
unresolved_conflicts: Personal profile branch and vector projection evidence are not globally deployed.

entities.title: ADD-EVENT-05 — Critical facts match
entities.definition: Title, date/time, timezone, city, venue, address, admission and canonical link agree across all event-bearing artifacts.
unresolved_conflicts: Recent stale repost incident demonstrates incomplete runtime prevention.

entities.title: ADD-MEDIA-02 — Smart focus and semantic media treatment
entities.definition: Faces, poster title and main objects remain usable across card, hero, gallery, related, email and share; OCR poster is not treated as a crop-ready photo.

confidence.basis: Canonical scenario and owner media rules.

unresolved_conflicts: Not every consumer uses one promoted media-frame contract.

entities.title: ADD-MEDIA-03 — Broken or missing media fallback
entities.definition: Broken, slow or absent media produces a clean typed fallback without layout shift, false metadata or loss of the event link.
unresolved_conflicts: Corrected UI SoT has unresolved mobile no-image materialization state.

entities.title: ADD-A11Y-01 — Keyboard and focus
entities.definition: Links, menus, gallery, modal, actions, email form and undo are keyboard operable with visible focus, no trap and correct focus return.
unresolved_conflicts: Screen-reader, high-contrast and native Safari coverage remain open.

entities.title: Search Stage 2 — browser, Android and iOS live health
entities.definition: Each accepted platform cell performs one real Search POST, renders five matching cards, performs real scroll/swipe, opens one event with HTTP 200 and records zero forbidden activity.
unresolved_conflicts: This is service health, not a quality/satisfaction benchmark for all intents.

entities.title: USR-04 — Search by genre and time
entities.definition: A user searches for events using a preferred genre and temporal intent.

confidence.basis: Original user scenario preserved in canonical inventory.

unresolved_conflicts: Exact intent fixture and satisfaction outcome are not accepted as a stable production benchmark.

entities.title: USR-05 — Search for a street performance
entities.definition: A user expresses a concrete event-type intent and receives relevant exact results or an honest no-match state.
unresolved_conflicts: Current inventory may contain no eligible street performance; no-match is not automatically a product failure.

entities.title: USR-14 — Search result boundary and confirmation
entities.definition: Structural skeleton persists until exact cards, feedback appears only after exact exhaustion, zero result is explicit and alternatives are separate.
unresolved_conflicts: Full production feedback/promotion pipeline evidence is incomplete.

entities.title: ADD-FAV-01 — Idempotent save
entities.definition: Repeated saving of one logical event creates no duplicate Favorite, ICS or reminder; badge counts unique saved events.

entities.title: ADD-FAV-02 — Complete current Favorites list
entities.definition: Favorites shows all unique saved events and distinguishes upcoming, moved, cancelled and ended lifecycle states.
unresolved_conflicts: Full local/cloud/account state evidence is incomplete.

entities.title: ADD-FAV-03 — Remove and undo
entities.definition: Removal from card, detail or Favorites converges to one state; undo restores one object and no duplicate reminder.

entities.title: ADD-FAV-04 — Correct ICS
entities.definition: Real calendar import preserves title, named location, coordinates/address, timezone, start/end, canonical URL, move and cancellation semantics.
unresolved_conflicts: Current-release native calendar imports are not attached for the full matrix.

entities.title: ADD-EVENT-01 — Multiple occurrences
entities.definition: Cards and detail expose explicit alternatives and intent actions preserve the selected occurrence's URL, ICS and reminder state.

entities.title: ADD-SHARE-01 — Adaptive event share
entities.definition: Mobile uses native share with accepted fallback; desktop uses the accepted clipboard flow; both target the exact canonical event.
unresolved_conflicts: Real OS share evidence is not uniformly attached.

entities.title: ADD-SHARE-03 — Honest cancel and fallback
entities.definition: Share cancel, permission denial, insecure context or unsupported API produce an honest non-success state and usable fallback.

entities.title: ADD-TR-01 — Transport eligibility
entities.definition: Transport context appears only for supported out-of-city events and never shows an irrelevant route for a city event.

entities.title: ADD-TR-02 — There/back feasibility
entities.definition: Transport allows arrival before event start and, when promised, departure after event end with accepted margins.
unresolved_conflicts: Fresh schedule evidence remains release-specific.

entities.title: ADD-TR-03 — Provider stale or partial failure
entities.definition: Unavailable rail/bus provider yields honestly fresh last-good or safe absence; one provider failure does not erase valid data from another.
unresolved_conflicts: Schedule failed-refresh drill remains a release gate.

entities.title: ADD-ID-01 — Identity state is consistent across pages
entities.definition: Login, logout, email add/forget and identity UI behave consistently on Home, listings, Search, detail, personal and Favorites surfaces.

confidence.basis: Canonical scenario; cross-page implementation is incomplete.

unresolved_conflicts: Search cannot remain the only owner of identity UI, but normalization is incomplete.

entities.title: ADD-ID-07 — Account switching isolation
entities.definition: After user A logs out and user B logs in, B cannot see A's Favorites, email, profile, tags or recommendations.
unresolved_conflicts: Complete production E2E evidence is missing.

entities.title: ADD-PERS-01 — Cold start
entities.definition: A new user receives a useful diverse static feed without empty UI, invented preferences or mandatory authorization.
unresolved_conflicts: Current Astro/public end-to-end evidence remains incomplete.

entities.title: ADD-PERS-03 — Signal deduplication
entities.definition: Reload, history, repeat click and transport replay do not create duplicate preference or action signals.

entities.title: ADD-PERS-04 — Not interesting and undo
entities.definition: Hide produces a clear non-navigation state, one authoritative signal and correct restore on undo across local/backend/next-feed state.
unresolved_conflicts: Full current Astro/public E2E is incomplete.

entities.title: ADD-PERS-06 — No hard information bubble
entities.definition: A mature golden persona reaches relevant events within the accepted window while retaining controlled new/diverse events outside known interests.
unresolved_conflicts: Golden persona and randomized production outcome evidence are incomplete.

entities.title: ADD-PERS-07 — No suitable current supply
entities.definition: When eligible inventory lacks a suitable event, the product does not fabricate relevance or classify the session as an algorithm failure without the supply denominator.
unresolved_conflicts: Suitable-event ground truth requires review or experiment context.

entities.title: ADD-BUILD-05 — Degraded network
entities.definition: Slow network, offline after first load, CDN media failure and unavailable personalization/Search APIs do not break static content, navigation, detail or ICS.
unresolved_conflicts: Full production-root matrix remains blocked by release state.

entities.title: ADD-DISC-01 — Empty and failed Search
entities.definition: Empty input, typo, no result, timeout/quota and offline produce understandable states and preserve the base static listing.
unresolved_conflicts: Accepted Stage 2 health is the normal path; every failure arm requires separate terminal evidence.

entities.title: ADD-OBS-01 — Failures are visible and correlated
entities.definition: Build, Search, share, email, transport and personalization failures retain a correlation reference without PII and the UI does not claim unaccepted success.
unresolved_conflicts: Unified correlation/evidence coverage differs across capabilities.

entities.title: ADD-BUILD-02 — Atomic promotion and rollback
entities.definition: A failed check never changes current; accepted complete tree promotes atomically and one verified rollback restores last-good without mixed assets.

confidence.basis: Canonical release scenario; live apply remains blocked.

unresolved_conflicts: Live ALB/SWS/DNS apply and rollback drill remain NO-GO.

entities.title: Action Map — no profile/rank write-back
entities.definition: Active diagnostic data, if separately enabled, causes zero profile mutation and zero current-rank influence; strong actions reconcile to their authoritative receipts.
unresolved_conflicts: Action map remains default-off and is not a public release requirement.
